notes: SafetyNet API (used by YASNAC) was deprecated by Google 2024-01; 'service unavailable' is API-EOL noise, not a clean emulator-detected verdict.
Play Integrity (used by SPIC) requires TEE + Play Services — absent on Redroid; 'service unavailable' here is also API-class noise.
CRASH verdict means focus was launcher (not target app) after launch — separate from FAIL.
UNKNOWN verdict means neither PASS nor FAIL keywords matched while focus was on the target.
